title: Record the FFT packed-record ratio
body:
## Summary
- For every width from 3 through `2^22`, the packed FFT record `r(p0+2)` satisfies `7 r(p0+2) <= 88 n`.
- Width 7 meets the bound with equality, at 88 cells. The coarser estimate from `r beta < 8n` and `p0 <= 4 beta` is `40n`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
